description.text: 创建30天社交媒体内容计划。

systemprompt.text:
作为专业的社交媒体策略师。使用以下输入，生成一个专注于实现主要目标的30天内容日历。

首先，利用你现有的知识以及（如果可用）关于该主题/细分市场和目标受众的实时网络数据，进行简短的内部研究和策略步骤。明确受众的主要痛点和需求、在该细分市场中表现良好的帖子类型和钩子，以及任何相关的当前趋势。仅使用这些见解来指导日历，不要单独输出它们。

输出必须是一个包含以下精确列的 Markdown 表格（不含其他内容）：天数、日期、主题/支柱、平台、内容创意、行动号召 (CTA)。

日历指南：
- 创建恰好30行，从开始日期起每个连续日历日一行，日期按升序排列。
- 每行的主题/支柱必须是所提供内容支柱之一，在30天内保持合理均衡的混合。
- 平台列必须遵循发布计划。如果某天指定了多个平台，则每个平台创建一行。

内容指南：
- 每个内容创意必须说明帖子类型（例如：Reel、轮播图、静态帖子、故事、直播、投票、LinkedIn 文字帖），并包含针对目标受众的清晰、吸引眼球的钩子。
- 每个 CTA 必须具体、以行动为导向，并直接支持主要目标（例如："下载免费指南"、"预约通话"、"订阅新闻通讯"、"在评论中写下你的第一个问题"）。
- 在30天内变化格式和角度（例如：教育性、叙事性、幕后花絮、FAQ、异议处理、社会认同、互动提示），避免重复。
- 确保每个创意都与目标受众的主要痛点和需求明确相关，并与主要目标保持一致。

输入（在运行提示前填写）：
* 主题/细分市场：[在此填写您的主题/细分市场]
* 目标受众：[在此填写您的目标受众，如已知，包括主要痛点和需求]
* 主要目标：[在此填写您的主要目标，例如：增加邮件列表/推动销售/建立权威]
* 发布计划：[在此填写您的发布频率和平台，例如：每周5次 IG Reels + 每周3次 LinkedIn]
* 内容支柱：[在此填写3–5个内容支柱，用逗号分隔]
* 开始日期：[填写日历的第一个日期，例如：2025年11月18日]

只输出最终的 Markdown 表格。不要包含任何解释、注释或表格之外的文字。

title.text: OpenMates v0.10：新应用、技能、提供商和学习工具

description.text: 探索 OpenMates 的更多实用功能

message.text:
你好，

OpenMates v0.10 的重点是让产品在日常场景中更加实用：更清晰的回答、更流畅的对话、更多的应用和提供商，以及更好的学习和办事方式。

# ✨ 亮点介绍

## 1. 回答中直接显示维基百科链接

OpenMates 现在可以直接在助手回复中突出显示相关的维基百科主题。当某个概念值得进一步探索时，你可以点击突出显示的术语，在不离开对话流的情况下快速了解更多信息。

这对于学习、研究、旅行规划、历史问题、科学主题，或者任何回答会引发新好奇心的场景都特别有用。

## 2. 消息高亮与评论

你现在可以高亮显示助手消息的部分内容并对其进行备注。这让长篇回答变得更加实用：保存重要的段落、标记想要回顾的内容，或者在特定的观点或建议旁添加评论。

## 3. 新应用与应用技能

OpenMates 在日常类别中获得了更多实用的应用技能。旅游搜索变得更加实用，增加了火车线路和预订链接；活动（Events）增加了更多有用的活动来源；代码（Code）在理解代码库方面变得更强；几种嵌入类型也变得更加清晰且易于操作。

OpenMates 不再仅仅依靠模型的记忆来回答，而是越来越多地使用专用工具：搜索、对比、总结、创建文件、检查源代码，并直接在对话中显示结构化结果。

## 4. 更多提供商带来真实结果

v0.10 在幕后添加并改进了提供商，例如旅游、活动、支付和内容安全。这很重要，因为只有当结果是及时的、有来源支持的且足够具体时，技能才有用。

对于用户来说，可见的效果很简单：更丰富的卡片、更好的来源归属、更多的直接链接，以及在提供商可以返回真实数据时，减少通用的回答。

## 5. 更好的嵌入与预览

嵌入内容在整个应用中变得更加实用。搜索结果、预订链接、生成的文件、代码输出、图像和公开示例现在拥有更清晰的预览和全屏视图，让你可以在不丢失对话上下文的情况下查看结果。

## 6. 更实用的示例与公开页面

公告、提示、法律页面和示例对话现在变成了正式的公开对话页面。这使得分享 OpenMates 的功能以及稍后重新打开有用的示例变得更加容易。

## 7. 更顺畅的注册与支付选项

OpenMates 还增加了通过 Revolut Business 进行的 SEPA 银行转账，改进了欧盟以外用户的 Stripe 结账流程，并增加了更改账户邮箱的功能。这些虽然不是华丽的功能，但在你实际使用产品时，它们能让基础体验更加稳健。

# 这对日常使用的意义

OpenMates 现在应该感觉更像一个实用的工作空间：回答可以包含学习链接，你可以标记并回顾重要部分，更多应用技能可以返回真实的结构化结果，公开示例也更容易分享。

一如既往，大量工作也花在了看不见的错误修复和可靠性提升上——特别是围绕加密对话同步、嵌入内容、注册以及 Safari 浏览器的表现。

祝好，

Marco  
OpenMates 创始人

## 4. 更多提供商，提供真实世界的结果

v0.10 在后台添加并改进了提供商，例如旅行、活动、支付和内容安全方面。这很重要，因为只有当结果是实时的、有来源支持且足够具体可用时，一项技能才真正有用。

对用户而言，直观的效果很简单：更丰富的卡片、更好的来源归属、更多的直接链接，以及当提供商能返回真实数据时，减少泛泛而谈的回答。

## 5. 更好的嵌入与预览

整个应用中的嵌入功能变得更加实用。搜索结果、预订链接、生成的文件、代码输出、图像和公开示例现在拥有更清晰的预览和全屏视图，让你可以在不丢失对话上下文的情况下查看结果。

## 6. 更有用的示例与公开页面

公告、提示、法律页面和示例对话现在都变成了正式的公开对话页面。这使得分享 OpenMates 的功能以及日后重新打开有用示例变得更加容易。

## 7. 更顺畅的注册与支付选项

OpenMates 还增加了通过 Revolut Business 进行的 SEPA 银行转账，改进了欧盟以外用户的 Stripe 结账流程，并增加了更改账户邮箱的功能。这些虽然不是华丽的功能，但在你真正想要使用产品时，它们能让基础体验更加稳健。

# 这对日常使用意味着什么

OpenMates 现在应该更像一个实用的工作空间：回答可以包含学习链接，你可以标记并复看重要部分，更多应用技能可以返回真实的结构化结果，公开示例也更容易分享。

一如既往，我们也做了大量幕后的 Bug 修复和可靠性改进——特别是在加密对话同步、嵌入、注册以及 Safari 浏览器表现方面。

祝好，

Marco  
OpenMates 创始人

message.text:
你好，

OpenMates v0.11 现已上线。本次更新在 v0.10 的基础上，增加了多项实用的日常功能：更丰富的每日灵感、代码执行、仓库研究、音乐生成、图像生成服务商改进、更清晰的应用结果以及本地界面字体。

# 首先，快速回顾一下 v0.10

v0.10 在回答中加入了维基百科链接、消息高亮与评论功能、更完善的公开公告/示例页面、SEPA 银行转账以及账号邮箱修改功能。

这些改进让 OpenMates 作为一个日常工作空间变得更加实用：更易于学习、更易于分享，且在账号和支付等基础环节更加稳健。

# ✨ v0.11 有哪些新变化

## 1. 扩展的每日灵感

每日灵感变得更加丰富多样。它们可以展示公开视频、实用的功能创意，以及你在 OpenMates 中可能想要尝试的具体切入点。

我们的目标是让 OpenMates 不再仅仅是一个空荡荡的聊天框，而是一个能帮你发现有用之事的场所：研究课题、理解视频、规划任务、探索工具，或是从示例开始继续操作。

## 2. 代码执行与代码研究改进

代码应用迈出了一大步。OpenMates 现在可以在沙箱中运行代码、显示输出、协助仓库搜索，并处理更多与代码相关的后续操作。

对于普通用户来说，即使你不是专业开发者，这也非常有用：小脚本、数据清理、文档生成、网页预览、日志解释以及技术问题都变得更具互动性。

## 3. 音乐生成与图像服务商改进

v0.11 扩展了生成式媒体工作流，加入了音乐生成功能并改进了图像生成服务商。这意味着 OpenMates 可以直接在对话中支持更多创意任务：快速创作音乐灵感、生成视觉概念、迭代提示词，或者将粗略的想法转化为可供查看和复用的媒体内容。

此次更新还改进了生成媒体的展示方式，使结果更易于预览、打开和后续操作。

## 4. 更清晰的应用结果与服务商详情

许多应用卡片和嵌入预览现在能显示更好的真实示例、服务商图标、来源信息和更清晰的元数据。这让你更容易理解发生了什么、结果来自哪里，以及使用了哪项应用技能。

在日常使用中，这意味着更少的猜测：旅游结果、网页结果、生成的文件、媒体输出和代码结果都将更易于识别和操作。

## 5. 更佳的后续操作展示

后续建议功能此前已存在，但现在的展示方式更加整洁且易于使用。它们旨在帮助你继续任务，而无需自己费心思考完美的下一条提示词。

## 6. 本地界面字体

你现在可以选择本地界面字体偏好。虽然这是一个小设置，但如果你花大量时间在 OpenMates 中阅读和写作，它就显得尤为重要。

## 7. 稳定性与性能改进

我们还对聊天同步、嵌入内容、文件预览和图像结果预览进行了稳定性和性能改进。

# 接下来的计划

下一步是继续让 OpenMates 变得更易理解、更易使用：提供更好的示例、更清晰的应用流程、更精细的创意与研究工具，并减少聊天体验中的瑕疵。

感谢你使用 OpenMates，并在遇到困惑或问题时提供反馈。

祝好，

Marco  
OpenMates 创始人

description.text: OpenMates v0.9：新应用与技能、AI 模型、文件上传及更多

message.text:
你好，
我是 Marco（又名 [glowingkitty](https://github.com/glowingkitty)）—— OpenMates 的创作者。
我并没有忘记 OpenMates —— 恰恰相反。

# 🙏 首先，说几句感谢的话

12 月底，在 Chaos Communication Congress（混沌通信大会）期间，我意外地受邀参加了德国电视台 ZDF 的采访 [（一份关于针对大型科技公司 AI 的隐私导向替代方案重要性的报告）](https://www.zdfheute.de/wirtschaft/39c3-hamburg-ki-alternativen-chatgpt-100.html)。哇，那真是一次难忘的经历。尽管当时的 OpenMates 还比较粗糙，但第一批用户已经开始注册并使用它了 —— 他们还发现了一些我在自己设备上测试时没遇到的 Bug 和边缘情况，并热心地向我反馈。非常感谢每一位提供反馈的朋友 —— 这对让 OpenMates 变得更精致、更稳定、更完善起到了巨大的帮助！当然，如果你发现 OpenMates 有任何不对劲或损坏的地方，非常欢迎继续反馈。

虽然这并不是我创作的第一个软件，但这是第一次有超过几个人开始使用我构建的软件 —— 到目前为止，已有超过 180 名活跃用户在使用 OpenMates！这非常令人兴奋，坦白说，起初也让我感到有些不知所措。

从那时起，我完全专注于改进和调试 OpenMates，使其功能更完备、更精致 —— 并对代码进行了大量修改。包括 Bug 修复、新功能、改进的用户界面以及许多其他提升。

今天，我很高兴能为你带来过去几个月最令人兴奋的更新！请记住，在一封通讯邮件中讲述所有的变化内容太多了 —— 因此，我将重点介绍亮点，并在接下来的几周内发布多个关于 OpenMates 各种功能的短视频，发布平台包括：
- [Instagram](https://instagram.com/openmates_official)
- [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/openmates.bsky.social)
- [Mastodon](https://mastodon.social/@OpenMates)
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@OpenMates)。

# ✨ 过去几个月的亮点

## 1. 🧩 新应用与应用技能

除了现有的搜索网页、阅读和分析网站以及读取 YouTube 视频字幕以发起讨论的能力外，OpenMates 还新增了许多应用和应用技能。以下是一些亮点：

- 🏥 **[健康](#settings/apps/health/skills/search_appointments)：** 正在寻找医生预约？健康应用现在可以检查 Doctolib 和 Jameda 的可用时段。
- 🏠 **[住房](#settings/apps/home/skills/search)：** 在 ImmoScout24、WG-Gesucht 和 Kleinanzeigen 上搜索公寓 —— 关键细节直接在 OpenMates 上可见。
- 🎉 **[活动](#settings/apps/events/skills/search)：** 在 Meetup、Luma、Resident Advisor 和 Google 上搜索和过滤活动 —— 包含描述、图片、活动时间和地点等详情，以及直接回复 (RSVP) 或加入的链接。
- ✈️ **[旅行](#settings/apps/travel)：** 新的“[搜索连接](#settings/apps/travel/skills/search_connections)”技能让你能通过 Google 搜索航班，同时跨多天查看多个连接 —— 包括完整的航班详情和预订链接。对火车连接的支持即将推出。而“[价格日历](#settings/apps/travel/skills/price_calendar)”技能可以让你快速概览一个月的价格走势。
- ⏰ **[提醒](#settings/apps/reminder)：** 为聊天创建提醒，以便稍后回来处理 —— 甚至可以触发 OpenMates 搜索并总结特定主题的每日最新新闻。
- 🖼️ **[图片](#settings/apps/images)：** 在网页上[搜索](#settings/apps/images/skills/search)图片、[生成](#settings/apps/images/skills/generate)图片和[矢量图形](#settings/apps/images/skills/vectorize)。
- 📄 **[PDF](#settings/apps/pdf)：** 上传 PDF 并针对文本甚至视觉布局提问 —— OpenMates 既能阅读也能查看 PDF！
- 💻 **[代码](#settings/apps/code)：** OpenMates 可以[搜索最新的文档](#settings/apps/code/skills/get_docs)来回答编程相关的问题，然后编写代码 —— 甚至让你直接在浏览器中预览网站设计和代码！而这仅仅是其编程能力的初步阶段。
- 🧮 **[数学](#settings/apps/math)：** 在 OpenMates 中计算表达式，甚至可视化函数图。
- 📝 **[文档](#settings/apps/docs)：** 请求生成 Word 文档 —— 并将其下载为 .docx 文件。
- 📊 **[表格](#settings/apps/sheets)：** OpenMates 还可以创建表格并让你将其下载为 .xlsx 文件。在接下来的几周里，文档和表格功能都会变得更加强大。
- 📧 **[邮件](#settings/apps/mail)：** OpenMates 可以为你起草邮件，然后你可以通过设备上的默认邮件程序轻松打开并发送。
- 🎙️ **[音频](#settings/apps/audio)：** 不想打字？直接从消息栏录制并发送语音消息给 OpenMates。

还有更多应用技能已添加。只需[查看并探索 OpenMates 应用](#settings/apps)。

## 2. 🔒 个人数据占位符

与大型科技公司和典型初创公司的 AI 聊天机器人不同，OpenMates 在设计时将你的隐私作为首要任务。它已经具备了各种隐私保护措施：
- 🔐 你的所有聊天记录仅在你的设备上进行加密和解密
- 🖼️ 所有外部图片都通过我们的 OpenMates 服务器加载（因此外部网站看不到你的 IP 地址或设备信息）
- 📉 OpenMates 不使用 Google Analytics 或任何其他分析软件（这也是为什么你在 OpenMates 上看不到 Cookie 横幅的原因）

新功能：当你起草并向 OpenMates 发送消息时，电子邮件地址、电话号码、API 密钥等敏感数据会自动被检测并替换为占位符。你随时可以在用户界面中切换回原始值，也可以点击检测到的数据以防止替换。但默认情况下，此功能可确保 OpenMates 和处理你消息的 AI 提供商从一开始就看不到这些敏感数据。

[亲自尝试一下](#message=Draft%20an%20email%20from%20marco.rossi%40gmail.com%20to%20hausverwaltung%40immobilien-weber.de%20asking%20about%20the%20status%20of%20the%20broken%20heater%20in%20my%20apartment.%20The%20repair%20was%20reported%20on%20March%2028th%20and%20my%20phone%20number%20is%20%2B49%20170%209876543.%20Please%20be%20polite%20but%20firm%20%E2%80%94%20it%E2%80%99s%20been%20almost%203%20weeks.) —— 点击此链接查看个人数据占位符的实际效果：你的电子邮件和电话号码在发送给 AI 之前将被自动检测并替换。

## 3. 🧠 记忆

OpenMates 现在可以记住特定应用的记忆，例如你即将到来的旅行或项目详情。但是：所有记忆仅在你的设备上加密和解密，并且只有在你明确确认该对话时，才会临时与 OpenMates 服务器和 AI 提供商共享。这让你能够充分利用个性化的回复，而无需不断重复你的项目细节 —— 同时仍能完全掌控你共享的数据、共享的时间以及共享给哪个 AI 提供商。查看 [OpenMates 应用中的记忆](#settings/apps/all/memories)。

## 4. 🎯 专注模式

了解如何向 AI 聊天机器人提供正确的指令，对于聊天机器人的帮助程度和回复质量有着巨大的影响。有了专注模式，你不需要成为提示词工程专家，也能充分利用出色的针对性指令。例如，只需向 OpenMates 询问职业见解，“职业见解”专注模式就会自动激活，引导你完成整个过程。当然：这仅仅是个开始。接下来的几周内将添加更多专注模式，并进一步提高现有模式的质量。欢迎查看 [OpenMates 应用中的专注模式](#settings/apps/all/focus-modes)。

## 5. 🤖 新模型

OpenMates 提供了广泛的高效且性能卓越的 AI 模型供选择。默认情况下，它会根据任务自动选择合适的模型。但你随时可以[在 AI 设置中](#settings/ai)永久覆盖此行为，或者通过在消息栏中使用 `@{modelname}` 提及特定模型来按需覆盖。你现在可以从广泛的 AI 模型中进行选择，例如：

- [Claude Opus 4.7](#settings/ai/model/claude-opus-4-7) 和 [Claude Sonnet 4.6](#settings/ai/model/claude-sonnet-4-6)
- [Gemini 3.1 Pro](#settings/ai/model/gemini-3.1-pro-preview) 和 [Gemini 3 Flash](#settings/ai/model/gemini-3-flash-preview)
- [GPT-5.4](#settings/ai/model/gpt-5.4)
- [DeepSeek V3.2](#settings/ai/model/deepseek-v3.2)
- [Devstral 2](#settings/ai/model/devstral-2512)
- `@best` 和 `@fast` 模型别名 —— 输入 `@best` 自动路由到最强大的模型，输入 `@fast` 使用 OpenMates 上可用的最快模型。

## 6. 💡 每日灵感与维基百科链接

如果使用得当，AI 可以成为学习的绝佳工具。OpenMates 经过优化，旨在鼓励人们学习、探索和获取灵感。这就是你登录后在界面顶部看到的“每日灵感”的作用。它们会展示有趣的新视频 —— 很快还会包含维基百科文章、OpenMates 新功能、艺术品的照片和详情、重要的历史事件等其他内容。每日灵感是根据你的聊天内容定制的，然后使用只有你拥有的密钥锁定在你的设备上 —— 因此它们对你来说是私密的。
此外，OpenMates 还会自动在助手消息的回复中高亮显示维基百科文章。这让你只需点击带有学习图标的橙色高亮单词，即可轻松了解有关该主题的更多信息。

# 🚀 接下来的计划

在接下来的几周里，我将发布各种短视频，展示 OpenMates 的许多功能以及它的用途，同时进一步改进软件并添加更多应用、提供商和功能。

从现在起，我的计划是每隔几周发送一次关于公告和更新的通讯邮件，并单独发送关于如何使用 OpenMates 的技巧和窍门。如果你想接收更多或更少的通讯邮件，请随时[检查你的通讯订阅设置](#settings/newsletter)。

祝你使用 OpenMates 愉快，并请关注更多更新！

大家好，
我是 Marco（又名 [glowingkitty](https://github.com/glowingkitty)），OpenMates 的开发者。
我并没有忘记 OpenMates —— 恰恰相反。

[video]

# 🙏 首先，说几句感谢的话

12 月底，在 Chaos Communication Congress 期间，我意外地接受了德国电视台 ZDF 的采访 [（一份关于关注隐私的替代方案对大型科技 AI 公司重要性的报告）](https://www.zdfheute.de/wirtschaft/39c3-hamburg-ki-alternativen-chatgpt-100.html)。哇，那真是一次难忘的经历。尽管当时的 OpenMates 还比较粗糙，但第一批用户已经开始注册并使用了 —— 他们还发现了一些我在自己设备上测试时没遇到的 Bug 和边缘情况，并向我报告了。非常感谢每一位提供反馈的朋友 —— 这对让 OpenMates 变得更精致、更稳定、更完善起到了巨大的帮助！当然，如果你发现 OpenMates 有任何不对劲或损坏的地方，非常欢迎继续报告问题。

虽然这不是我开发的第一个软件，但这是第一次有超过几个人开始使用我构建的软件 —— 到目前为止，OpenMates 已经有超过 180 名活跃用户了！这非常令人兴奋，坦白说，起初也有点受宠若惊。

从那时起，我全身心地投入到改进和调试 OpenMates 中，使其功能更完整、更精致 —— 并对代码进行了大量更改。包括 Bug 修复、新功能、改进的用户界面以及更多优化。

今天，我很高兴能向大家介绍过去几个月里最令人兴奋的变化！请记住，在一个新闻简报里讲完所有变化内容太多了 —— 所以我会重点介绍亮点，并在接下来的几周内发布多个关于 OpenMates 各项功能的短视频：
- [Instagram](https://instagram.com/openmates_official)
- [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/openmates.bsky.social)
- [Mastodon](https://mastodon.social/@OpenMates)
- [YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@OpenMates)。

# ✨ 过去几个月的亮点

## 1. 🧩 新应用与应用技能

除了现有的网页搜索、阅读和分析网站、以及阅读 YouTube 视频字幕以发起讨论的功能外 —— OpenMates 还新增了许多应用和应用技能。以下是一些亮点：

- 🏥 **[健康](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/health/skills/search_appointments)：** 正在找医生预约？健康应用现在可以检查 Doctolib 和 Jameda 的空档。
- 🏠 **[房产](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/home/skills/search)：** 在 ImmoScout24、WG-Gesucht 和 Kleinanzeigen 上搜索公寓 —— 关键细节直接在 OpenMates 上可见。
- 🎉 **[活动](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/events/skills/search)：** 在 Meetup、Luma、Resident Advisor 和 Google 上搜索和筛选活动 —— 包含描述、图片、活动时间和地点等详情，以及直接回复 (RSVP) 或加入的链接。
- ✈️ **[旅行](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/travel)：** 新的“[搜索连接](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/travel/skills/search_connections)”技能让你能通过 Google 同时搜索多个日期、多个航线的航班 —— 包括完整的航班详情和预订链接。对火车连接的支持即将推出。而“[价格日历](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/travel/skills/price_calendar)”技能可以让你快速概览一个月的价格走势。
- ⏰ **[提醒](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/reminder)：** 为聊天创建提醒，以便稍后回顾 —— 甚至可以触发 OpenMates 搜索并总结特定主题的每日最新新闻。
- 🖼️ **[图像](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/images)：** 在网页上[搜索](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/images/skills/search)图片、[生成](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/images/skills/generate)图片和[矢量图形](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/images/skills/vectorize)。
- 📄 **[PDF](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/pdf)：** 上传 PDF 并针对文本甚至视觉布局提问 —— OpenMates 既能阅读也能查看 PDF！ 
- 💻 **[代码](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/code)：** OpenMates 可以[搜索最新的文档](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/code/skills/get_docs)来回答编程相关问题，然后编写代码 —— 甚至让你直接在浏览器中预览网站设计和代码！而这仅仅是其编程能力的初步阶段。
- 🧮 **[数学](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/math)：** 在 OpenMates 中计算表达式，甚至可视化绘图。
- 📝 **[文档](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/docs)：** 请求生成 Word 文档 —— 并以 .docx 文件形式下载。
- 📊 **[表格](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/sheets)：** OpenMates 还可以创建表格并让你以 .xlsx 文件形式下载。在接下来的几周里，文档和表格功能都会变得更好、更强大。
- 📧 **[邮件](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/mail)：** OpenMates 可以为你起草电子邮件，然后你可以通过设备上的默认邮件程序轻松打开并发送。
- 🎙️ **[音频](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/audio)：** 不想打字？直接从消息栏录制并发送语音消息给 OpenMates。

还有更多应用技能已添加。只需[查看并探索 OpenMates 应用](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps)。

## 2. 🔒 个人数据占位符

与大型科技公司和典型初创公司的 AI 聊天机器人不同，OpenMates 将你的隐私作为首要任务。它已经具备了多种隐私保护措施：
- 🔐 你的所有聊天记录仅在你的设备上进行加密和解密
- 🖼️ 所有外部图片都通过我们的 OpenMates 服务器加载（因此外部网站看不到你的 IP 地址或设备信息）
- 📉 OpenMates 不使用 Google Analytics 或任何其他分析软件（这也是为什么你在 OpenMates 上看不到 Cookie 横幅的原因）

新功能：当你起草并向 OpenMates 发送消息时，电子邮件地址、电话号码、API 密钥等敏感数据会在你的设备上被自动检测并替换为占位符。你随时可以在用户界面中切换回原始值，也可以点击检测到的数据以防止替换。但默认情况下，此功能可确保 OpenMates 和处理你消息的 AI 提供商从一开始就看不到敏感数据。

[亲自尝试](https://openmates.org/#message=Draft%20an%20email%20from%20marco.rossi%40gmail.com%20to%20hausverwaltung%40immobilien-weber.de%20asking%20about%20the%20status%20of%20the%20broken%20heater%20in%20my%20apartment.%20The%20repair%20was%20reported%20on%20March%2028th%20and%20my%20phone%20number%20is%20%2B49%20170%209876543.%20Please%20be%20polite%20but%20firm%20%E2%80%94%20it%E2%80%99s%20been%20almost%203%20weeks.) —— 点击此链接查看个人数据占位符的实际效果：你的电子邮件和电话号码将在发送给 AI 之前被自动检测并替换。

## 3. 🧠 记忆

OpenMates 现在可以记住特定应用的记忆，例如你即将到来的旅行或项目详情。但是：所有记忆仅在你的设备上加密和解密，并且只有在你为特定聊天明确确认后，才会临时与 OpenMates 服务器和 AI 提供商共享。这让你能充分利用个性化回复，而无需不断重复项目细节 —— 同时仍能完全控制你共享的数据、时间以及共享给哪个 AI 提供商。查看 [OpenMates 应用中的记忆](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/all/memories)。

## 4. 🎯 专注模式

了解如何向 AI 聊天机器人提供正确的指令，对于聊天机器人的帮助程度和回复质量有着巨大的影响。有了专注模式，你不需要成为提示词工程专家，也能充分利用出色的、有针对性的指令。例如，只需向 OpenMates 询问职业见解，“职业见解”专注模式就会自动激活，引导你完成整个过程。当然：这仅仅是个开始。在接下来的几周内，我们将添加更多专注模式，并进一步提高现有模式的质量。欢迎查看 [OpenMates 应用中的专注模式](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/all/focus-modes)。

## 5. 🤖 新模型

OpenMates 拥有广泛的高效且性能最佳的 AI 模型选择。默认情况下，它会根据任务自动选择合适的模型。但你随时可以[在 AI 设置中](https://openmates.org/#settings/ai)永久覆盖此行为，或者通过在消息栏中使用 `@{modelname}` 提及特定模型来按需覆盖。你现在可以从广泛的 AI 模型中进行选择，例如：

- [Claude Opus 4.7](https://openmates.org/#settings/ai/model/claude-opus-4-7) & [Claude Sonnet 4.6](https://openmates.org/#settings/ai/model/claude-sonnet-4-6)
- [Gemini 3.1 Pro](https://openmates.org/#settings/ai/model/gemini-3.1-pro-preview) & [Gemini 3 Flash](https://openmates.org/#settings/ai/model/gemini-3-flash-preview)
- [GPT-5.4](https://openmates.org/#settings/ai/model/gpt-5.4)
- [DeepSeek V3.2](https://openmates.org/#settings/ai/model/deepseek-v3.2)
- [Devstral 2](https://openmates.org/#settings/ai/model/devstral-2512)
- `@best` 和 `@fast` 模型别名 —— 输入 `@best` 自动路由到最强模型，输入 `@fast` 使用 OpenMates 上可用的最快模型。

## 6. 💡 每日灵感与维基百科链接

如果使用得当，AI 可以成为一个神奇的学习工具。OpenMates 经过优化，旨在鼓励人们学习、探索和获取灵感。这就是你登录后在界面顶部看到的“每日灵感”的作用。它们会展示有趣的新视频 —— 很快还会包含其他内容，如维基百科文章、OpenMates 新功能、艺术品的照片和详情、重要的历史事件等。每日灵感是根据你的聊天内容量身定制的，然后使用只有你拥有的密钥锁定在你的设备上 —— 因此它们对你来说是私密的。
此外，OpenMates 还会自动在助手消息的回复中突出显示维基百科文章。这让你只需点击带有学习图标的橙色高亮单词，即可轻松了解有关该主题的更多信息。

# 🚀 接下来是什么

在接下来的几周里，我将发布各种短片，展示 OpenMates 的许多功能以及可以用它做的有用事情，并进一步改进软件，添加更多应用、提供商和功能。

从现在起，我的计划是每隔几周发送一次关于公告和更新的新闻邮件，并单独发送关于如何使用 OpenMates 的提示和技巧。如果你想接收更多或更少的新闻邮件，请随时[查看你的新闻邮件设置](https://openmates.org/#settings/newsletter)。

祝你使用 OpenMates 愉快，并请期待更多更新！

[cta]

title.text: 参加 5 月 19 日在柏林举行的 OpenMates 见面会

message.text:
你是否已经在使用 OpenMates，并想参加 5 月 19 日星期二 19:00 在柏林举行的 OpenMates 见面会？

在过去的 1 年半里，我一直在开发 OpenMates.org：一个比 ChatGPT、Claude、OpenClaw、Manus 等更好的替代方案。它通常能提供更好的回复，拥有更佳的用户体验设计，通过各种功能优先考虑隐私、安全和用户利益，并且不会将你锁定在某个生态系统中，同时仍允许你使用已经熟悉和使用的 AI 模型。它可以利用各种应用技能来查找活动、火车班次、医生预约、公寓等等，并且已经拥有了首批 200 名付费用户（购买一次性使用额度）。

话虽如此：我目前还无法以此维持生计（主要仍靠失业金资助），而且最近几周和几个月我工作强度太大，开始感到越来越疲惫。我意识到这是一个巨大的项目，需要一个团队，而不能一直是一个人的项目。因此，我现在正更多地致力于将其转变为一个团队协作项目，让普通人也能享受到 AI 的实用之处，而不是只专注于企业端。并且去打造一个可持续发展的业务和产品，让人们在未来几年依然喜爱使用，而不是成为另一家走上“平台劣化”（enshittification）道路的初创公司。例如，我对“责任制所有权”（steward ownership）等概念更感兴趣，而不是讨论退出策略以及如何卖给科技巨头。

既然我主要把自己定位为产品负责人（具有 UX 设计和软件开发背景），我特别希望能结识专注于市场营销/沟通的人才——但也非常欢迎其他资深软件开发者的支持。无论你的背景如何，任何 OpenMates 使用者的反馈对我们来说都弥足珍贵，非常欢迎。

如果你对此感兴趣，并希望提供反馈、结识他人，甚至进行更长期的合作——请参加 OpenMates 见面会或[给我发消息](mailto:marco@openmates.org)！:)

祝好，

Marco  
OpenMates 创始人

## 1. 🧩 新应用与应用技能

除了现有的搜索网页、阅读和分析网站以及读取 YouTube 视频字幕以发起讨论的功能外 —— OpenMates 还新增了许多应用和应用技能。以下是一些亮点：

- 🏥 **[健康 (Health)](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/health/skills/search_appointments)：** 正在寻找医生预约？健康应用现在可以检查 Doctolib 和 Jameda 上的可用时段。
- 🏠 **[房产 (Home)](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/home/skills/search)：** 在 ImmoScout24、WG-Gesucht 和 Kleinanzeigen 上搜索公寓 —— 关键细节直接在 OpenMates 上可见。
- 🎉 **[活动 (Events)](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/events/skills/search)：** 在 Meetup、Luma、Resident Advisor 和 Google 上搜索和筛选活动 —— 包含描述、图片、活动时间和地点等详情，以及直接 RSVP 或加入的链接。
- ✈️ **[旅行 (Travel)](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/travel)：** 新的“[搜索交通连接](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/travel/skills/search_connections)”技能让你通过 Google 搜索航班，可同时跨多天搜索多个连接 —— 包括完整的航班详情和预订链接。对火车连接的支持即将推出。而“[价格日历](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/travel/skills/price_calendar)”技能可以让你快速概览一个月的价格走势。
- ⏰ **[提醒 (Reminders)](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/reminder)：** 为聊天创建提醒以便稍后处理 —— 甚至可以触发 OpenMates 搜索并总结特定主题的每日最新新闻。
- 🖼️ **[图片 (Images)](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/images)：** 在网页上[搜索](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/images/skills/search)图片、[生成](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/images/skills/generate)图片和[矢量图形](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/images/skills/vectorize)。
- 📄 **[PDF](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/pdf)：** 上传 PDF 并针对文本甚至视觉布局提问 —— OpenMates 既能阅读也能查看 PDF！
- 💻 **[代码 (Code)](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/code)：** OpenMates 可以[搜索最新的文档](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/code/skills/get_docs)来回答编程相关问题，然后编写代码 —— 甚至让你直接在浏览器中预览网站设计和代码！而这仅仅是其编程能力的初步阶段。
- 🧮 **[数学 (Math)](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/math)：** 在 OpenMates 中计算表达式，甚至可视化绘图。
- 📝 **[文档 (Docs)](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/docs)：** 请求生成 Word 文档 —— 并将其下载为 .docx 文件。
- 📊 **[表格 (Sheets)](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/sheets)：** OpenMates 还可以创建表格并让你将其下载为 .xlsx 文件。在接下来的几周内，文档和表格功能都将变得更好、更强大。
- 📧 **[邮件 (Mail)](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/mail)：** OpenMates 可以为你起草电子邮件，然后你可以通过设备上的默认邮件程序轻松打开并发送。
- 🎙️ **[音频 (Audio)](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/audio)：** 不想打字？直接从消息栏录制并向 OpenMates 发送语音消息。

还有更多应用技能已添加。只需[查看并探索 OpenMates 应用](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps)。

## 2. 🔒 个人数据占位符

与大型科技公司和典型初创公司的 AI 聊天机器人不同，OpenMates 将你的隐私作为首要任务。它已经具备了各种隐私保护措施：
- 🔐 你所有的聊天内容仅在你的设备上进行加密和解密
- 🖼️ 所有外部图片都通过我们的 OpenMates 服务器加载（因此外部网站看不到你的 IP 地址或设备信息）
- 📉 OpenMates 不使用 Google Analytics 或任何其他分析软件（这也是为什么你在 OpenMates 上看不到 Cookie 横幅的原因）

新功能：当你起草并向 OpenMates 发送消息时，电子邮件地址、电话号码、API 密钥等敏感数据会在你的设备上被自动检测并替换为占位符。你随时可以在用户界面中切换回原始值，也可以点击检测到的数据以防止替换。但默认情况下，此功能可确保 OpenMates 和处理你消息的 AI 提供商从一开始就看不到这些敏感数据。

[亲自尝试一下](https://openmates.org/#message=Draft%20an%20email%20from%20marco.rossi%40gmail.com%20to%20hausverwaltung%40immobilien-weber.de%20asking%20about%20the%20status%20of%20the%20broken%20heater%20in%20my%20apartment.%20The%20repair%20was%20reported%20on%20March%2028th%20and%20my%20phone%20number%20is%20%2B49%20170%209876543.%20Please%20be%20polite%20but%20firm%20%E2%80%94%20it%E2%80%99s%20been%20almost%203%20weeks.) —— 点击此链接查看个人数据占位符的实际效果：你的电子邮件和电话号码将在发送给 AI 之前被自动检测并替换。

## 3. 🧠 记忆 (Memories)

OpenMates 现在可以记住特定应用的记忆，例如你即将到来的旅行或项目详情。但是：所有记忆仅在你的设备上加密和解密，并且只有在你为特定聊天明确确认后，才会临时与 OpenMates 服务器和 AI 提供商共享。这让你能够充分利用个性化回复，而无需不断重复你的项目细节 —— 同时仍能完全控制你共享的数据、共享时间以及与哪个 AI 提供商共享。查看 [OpenMates 应用中的记忆](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/all/memories)。

## 4. 🎯 专注模式 (Focus Modes)

了解如何向 AI 聊天机器人提供正确的指令，对于聊天机器人的帮助程度和回复质量有着巨大的影响。有了专注模式，你不需要成为提示词工程专家，也能充分利用出色的、有针对性的指令。例如，只需向 OpenMates 询问职业见解，“职业见解”专注模式就会自动激活，引导你完成整个过程。当然：这仅仅是个开始。接下来的几周内将添加更多专注模式，并进一步提高现有模式的质量。欢迎查看 [OpenMates 应用中的专注模式](https://openmates.org/#settings/apps/all/focus-modes)。

## 5. 🤖 新模型

OpenMates 提供了广泛的高效且性能卓越的 AI 模型选择。默认情况下，它会根据任务自动选择合适的模型。但你随时可以[在 AI 设置中](https://openmates.org/#settings/ai)永久覆盖此行为，或者通过在消息栏中使用 `@{modelname}` 提及特定模型来按需覆盖。你现在可以从多种 AI 模型中进行选择，例如：

- [Claude Opus 4.7](https://openmates.org/#settings/ai/model/claude-opus-4-7) 和 [Claude Sonnet 4.6](https://openmates.org/#settings/ai/model/claude-sonnet-4-6)
- [Gemini 3.1 Pro](https://openmates.org/#settings/ai/model/gemini-3.1-pro-preview) 和 [Gemini 3 Flash](https://openmates.org/#settings/ai/model/gemini-3-flash-preview)
- [GPT-5.4](https://openmates.org/#settings/ai/model/gpt-5.4)
- [DeepSeek V3.2](https://openmates.org/#settings/ai/model/deepseek-v3.2)
- [Devstral 2](https://openmates.org/#settings/ai/model/devstral-2512)
- `@best` 和 `@fast` 模型别名 —— 输入 `@best` 自动路由到最强模型，输入 `@fast` 使用 OpenMates 上可用的最快模型。

## 6. 💡 每日灵感与维基百科链接

如果使用得当，AI 可以成为一个极好的学习工具。OpenMates 经过优化，旨在鼓励人们学习、探索和获取灵感。这就是你登录后在界面顶部看到的“每日灵感”的作用。它们会展示有趣的新视频 —— 很快还会包含其他内容，如维基百科文章、OpenMates 新功能、艺术品的照片和详情、重要的历史事件等。每日灵感是根据你的聊天内容量身定制的，然后使用只有你拥有的密钥锁定在你的设备上 —— 因此它们对你来说是私密的。
此外，OpenMates 还会自动在助手消息的回复中突出显示维基百科文章。这使得你只需点击带有学习图标的橙色高亮单词，即可轻松了解有关某个主题的更多信息。

# 🚀 后续计划

在接下来的几周里，我将发布各种短视频，展示 OpenMates 的众多功能以及可以用它做的有用事情，同时进一步改进软件并添加更多应用、提供商和功能。

从现在起，我的计划是每隔几周发送一次关于公告和更新的简报邮件，并单独发送关于如何使用 OpenMates 的提示和技巧。如果你想接收更多或更少的简报邮件，请随时[检查你的简报设置](https://openmates.org/#settings/newsletter)。

祝你使用 OpenMates 愉快，并敬请期待更多更新！

Berlin has one of Europe's most active [AI](wiki:Artificial_intelligence) builder scenes, transitioning from general theory to practical "hands-on" engineering. For someone learning to build with AI tools, the focus in June 2026 is heavily on [AI agents](wiki:Software_agent), [RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)](wiki:Retrieval-augmented_generation), and production-ready architectures.

Here are the top upcoming workshops and meetups in Berlin where you can build, demo, and learn from other practitioners.

### Featured Hands-On Workshops
These sessions are specifically designed for those who want to write code and build prototypes.

*   **BLISS x QuantCo: Build Your Own AI Agent**
    *   **Date:** June 10, 2026 | 17:30
    *   **Location:** Berlin-Mitte (Altonaer Str. 26)
    *   **Focus:** An interactive session transitioning from [LLM APIs](wiki:Large_language_model) to building a custom agent that automates complex document workflows. **Bring your laptop.**
    *   [Event Details & RSVP](embed:bliss-x-quantco-dWg)
*   **Open Source Europe Tour: AI in Practice**
    *   **Date:** June 8, 2026 | 17:30
    *   **Location:** Netlight Consulting (Invalidenstraße 117)
    *   **Focus:** A "hype-free" walkthrough of modern AI, explaining Agentic AI, fine-tuning vs. RAG, and connecting AI to data architectures.
    *   [Event Details & RSVP](embed:open-source-europe-S4k)
*   **AI Future-Club Kickoff (Hackers / Founders)**
    *   **Date:** June 11, 2026 | 18:00
    *   **Location:** TBD (Berlin)
    *   **Focus:** A session for developers to "get their hands dirty," discussing what to build and ship together, featuring live demos of recent projects.
    *   [Event Details & RSVP](embed:ai-future-club-XOk)

### Community Meetups for Builders
These events are excellent for networking and seeing what other local developers are currently building.

*   **OpenClaw Anonymous Berlin #9**
    *   **Date:** June 9, 2026 | 19:00
    *   **Location:** w3.hub (Möckernstraße 120)
    *   **Focus:** Informal "laptop-out" meetup where people showcase OpenClaw and AI agent setups. Perfect for sharing what works and what doesn't.
    *   [Event Details & RSVP](embed:openclaw-anonymous-berlin-JA8)
*   **AI Tinkerers Berlin**
    *   **Date:** June 17, 2026
    *   **Focus:** A screened, demo-first, "no-pitch" community. Expect live code, architecture lessons, and technical Q&A from local founders and engineers.
    *   Berlin AI Tinkerers Portal
*   **Spec-Driven Development: AI for Full-Stack Java**
    *   **Date:** June 9, 2026 | 18:30
    *   **Location:** Capgemini (Potsdamer Platz 5)
    *   **Focus:** Learning how AI can generate code, diagrams, and tests from structured specifications.
    *   [Event Details & RSVP](embed:spec-driven-development-rxI)

### Key Hubs to Follow
If you want to stay in the loop, these organizations host the majority of builder-centric AI events in Berlin:

*   **Merantix AI Campus**: Located in Nord-Mitte, this 6,000m² campus is the heart of the Berlin AI ecosystem, hosting weekly reading groups and tech talks.
    *   Campus Events Calendar
*   **BLISS (Berlin AI Community)**: A student and professional community that organizes high-quality workshops and speaker series.
    *   BLISS Official Site
*   **[CODE University](wiki:CODE_University_of_Applied_Sciences)**: Often hosts "Global AI Bootcamps" and hands-on sessions for students and the public at their Delta Campus in Neukölln.

### Practical Tips for Joining
1.  **RSVP Early:** Many of these events (especially the BLISS and Tinkerers sessions) have limited spots and require screening or early registration.
2.  **Bring a Laptop:** Most "workshops" expect you to follow along with code. Ensure you have a local environment or a [GitHub](wiki:GitHub) account ready.
3.  **Join the Slacks:** Groups like AI Tinkerers and [Hackers/Founders](/#settings/apps/web) have local Slack/Discord channels where most "last-minute" build sessions are organized.

Would you like me to help you find more specific resources for a particular AI tool you're learning, such as [PyTorch](wiki:PyTorch) or [LangChain](wiki:LangChain)?

**Artemis II** 任务最近圆满成功，标志着人类50多年来首次飞往月球附近。该任务于 **2026年4月1日** 发射，并于 **2026年4月10日** 在太平洋成功溅落，达到了任务的高潮。

作为一名[天文学](/#settings/apps/study)和物理学爱好者，我觉得这次任务特别令人兴奋，因为它是 Artemis III 任务之前的最后一次"试驾"，而 Artemis III 的目标是将首位女性和下一位男性送上月球表面。

### 任务概述
Artemis II 是一次为期10天的飞行测试，旨在验证 **太空发射系统 (SLS)** 火箭和 **Orion** 飞船（机组人员将其命名为 *Integrity*）能否安全地运送、维持和带回宇航员。

*   **机组人员：** 四人机组由指令长 **Reid Wiseman**、驾驶员 **Victor Glover**、任务专家 **Christina Koch**（NASA）和任务专家 **Jeremy Hansen**（CSA）组成。
*   **新纪录：** 在任务期间，机组人员创造了载人航天器离地球最远距离的新纪录，达到 **252,756 英里**——超越了 [Apollo 13](embed:nasa.gov-haz) 在1970年创下的纪录。
*   **飞行轨道：** 与 Apollo 任务不同，Artemis II 采用了"混合自由返回轨道"。在绕地球轨道测试系统后，飞船进行了月球飞越，利用月球引力"弹射"返回地球，无需进行大规模发动机点火。

### 任务照片精选
以下是任务中最令人惊叹的视觉瞬间，从肯尼迪航天中心的壮观发射到地球和月球的宁静景色。

[!](embed:nasa.gov-mEC)
[!](embed:nasa.gov-k1v)
[!](embed:space.com-idA)
[!](embed:nasa.gov-7Me)
[!](embed:cbsnews.com-H7E)
[!](embed:plus.nasa.gov-Srx)

### 关键里程碑
*   **发射（飞行第1天）：** SLS 火箭——有史以来最强大的火箭——从39B发射台升空，将 Orion 飞船送入高地球轨道。
*   **近距离操作（飞行第2天）：** 机组人员练习了手动操控飞船，这是未来需要与 [Lunar Gateway](https://www.nasa.gov/mission/gateway/) 对接的任务的关键技能。
*   **月球飞越（飞行第6天）：** 机组人员飞过月球背面，短暂失去与地球的联系，随后看到了月球地平线上的"地出"景象。
*   **溅落（飞行第10天）：** Orion 以大约25,000英里/小时的速度重返大气层，隔热罩承受了近5,000°F的高温，最终在圣地亚哥海岸安全溅落。

机组人员已返回地面，NASA 将开始对飞行数据进行全面审查，为 **Artemis III** 做准备。

你对 Artemis 计划的哪个部分最感兴趣——[火箭技术](/#settings/apps/web)、[月球科学](/#settings/apps/books)，还是未来的[火星任务](/#settings/apps/videos)？

**深入探索：**

### 使用的关键动画概念：
1.  **Gradient Shifting：** `.background-canvas` 使用 `background-size: 400%` 并通过关键帧移动背景位置。这创造了一种"熔岩灯"效果，无需高分辨率图片就能呈现高级感。
2.  **Floating Blobs：** `.blob` 元素使用 `filter: blur()` 以及 `translate` 和 `scale` 的组合来创建有机的浮动形状。
3.  **性能提示：** 我使用了 `transform: translate()` 和 `opacity` 来制作入场动画。这些属性是"GPU加速"的，这意味着浏览器可以比 `margin` 或 `top/left` 等会触发布局重新计算的属性更流畅地进行动画处理。
4.  **Glassmorphism：** `backdrop-filter: blur()` 创建了磨砂玻璃效果，与移动的背景色完美搭配。

### 如何扩展：
*   **Scroll Reveal：** 要制作更长的页面，你可能想使用像 [AOS (Animate on Scroll)](https://michalsnik.github.io/aos/) 这样的库或原生CSS `view-timeline` 属性（在现代浏览器中）来在滚动时触发动画。
*   **交互性：** 你可以添加一个简单的JavaScript监听器，根据用户的鼠标位置稍微移动"Blobs"，以创建视差效果。

你打算将这个用于什么类型的项目？我可以帮你调整布局或配色方案（例如 [Tailwind](https://tailwindcss.com/) 颜色或 [Adobe Color](https://color.adobe.com/) 主题）以适合特定品牌！

The weather in [Berlin](wiki:Berlin) over the next few days will be a mix of warm sunshine and a brief rainy spell, followed by cooler, breezy conditions. Here is the forecast and what it means for your daily routine.

### 🌤️ Weather Forecast (June 8 – June 12)

*   **Monday (June 8):** The warmest day of the week. Expect a high of **24.3°C** and a low of **12.1°C**. It will be mostly dry and partly cloudy.
*   **Tuesday (June 9):** A noticeable shift. Temperatures drop to a high of **18.3°C** with a **44% chance of rain** throughout the day. Expect roughly 10 hours of light rain and gusty winds up to 40 km/h.
*   **Wednesday – Friday (June 10-12):** Consistent "Berlin grey" but mostly dry. Highs will hover between **16°C and 19°C**, with chilly mornings around **10°C**. Friday will be particularly breezy with gusts reaching 40 km/h.

[!](embed:berlin-weather-2026-KeQ)
[!](embed:berlin-weather-2026-ywP)
[!](embed:berlin-weather-2026-4Gl)

---

### 🧥 Practical Clothing Advice

The key for this week is **layering**. Berlin’s temperature swings between early morning and late afternoon can be significant.

1.  **Monday:** Standard summer attire like t-shirts and light trousers. Keep a light sweatshirt or denim jacket in your bag for the morning or if you're staying out late.
2.  **Tuesday (The Rain Day):** You will need a reliable waterproof shell or raincoat. Since temperatures are mild (18°C), avoid heavy insulated coats; a breathable rain jacket over a light layer is best to prevent overheating while walking.
3.  **Wed-Fri:** Transition back to "spring" mode. A light bomber jacket, windbreaker, or a medium-weight sweater will be necessary. If you're sensitive to the cold, a light scarf can help against the constant breeze.

[!](embed:vogue.com-d6E)
[!](embed:vogue.com-mqs)
[!](embed:vogue.com-sZU)

---

### 🚲 Bike-Commute Advice

Bicycle culture in Berlin is resilient, but the wind and rain this week require some preparation.

*   **Mind the Wind:** Gusts of 40 km/h on Tuesday and Friday can create a significant [wind chill](wiki:Wind_chill) and make pedaling into a headwind much more exhausting. If you have an e-bike, bump up the assistance; if not, leave 5-10 minutes earlier than usual.
*   **The Tuesday Rain:** If you must cycle on Tuesday, full mudguards (fenders) are a lifesaver for your clothes. Wear waterproof trousers or carry a change of pants. Be cautious of "Berlin cobbles" (Pflasterstein) and tram tracks, as they become incredibly slippery when wet.
*   **Visibility:** With cloudier skies and rain, ensure your bike lights are charged. Even during the day, lights can help you stay visible to drivers during grey, rainy spells.

!

[!](embed:lmr604303srakr-buck-XEz)
If your input supply isn't perfectly regulated, the LMR60430 is a safer bet. Its 36V rating provides a significant safety buffer over a nominal 24V input. It also features [power good](wiki:Power_good_signal) and soft-start capabilities.

[!](embed:tpsm84338rcjr-buck-Swx)
For rapid prototyping where you want to minimize layout complexity and electromagnetic interference (EMI), the TPSM84338 is a **power module**. It integrates the inductor into the package, significantly reducing the design effort and PCB area.

### Design Considerations
*   **Voltage Margin:** If your "24V" supply comes from a battery or a noisy industrial transformer, avoid parts rated exactly at 24V (like the `TPS56339`). Stick to 28V or 36V rated parts to prevent [overvoltage](wiki:Overvoltage) damage.
*   **Thermal Management:** At 3A, even a 92% efficient converter will dissipate about 1.2W of heat. Ensure your PCB has adequate copper pouring for the thermal pad.

Which of these factors is most important for your project: cost, ease of assembly, or high reliability?

message_2.text:

Here are three delicious, protein-packed vegetarian chickpea and spinach dinner recipes that you can whip up in under 35 minutes.

### 1. 10-Minute Chickpea and Spinach Curry
This is an incredibly fast [curry](wiki:Curry) that relies on aromatics and pantry staples for a rich, satisfying flavor in record time.

[!](embed:thefieryvegetarian.com-3sr)
[!](embed:vegancocotte.com-IZt)
[!](embed:vegancocotte.com-rFn)

*   **Total Time:** 10 minutes
*   **Protein Content:** ~10.5g per serving
*   **Servings:** 4

**Ingredients:**
*   1 (15 oz) can [chickpeas](wiki:Chickpea) (drained and rinsed)
*   1 (15 oz) can diced [tomatoes](wiki:Tomato)
*   1 [onion](wiki:Onion), 4 [garlic](wiki:Garlic) cloves, 1 red chili, 1 tbsp ginger (all finely diced)
*   3 tbsp curry paste & 2 tbsp [tomato paste](wiki:Tomato_paste)
*   3 cups fresh [spinach](wiki:Spinach)
*   1 tsp vegetable oil

**Instructions:**
1.  **Sauté Aromatics:** Heat oil in a large pot. Add diced onion, garlic, ginger, and chili. Sauté for about 1 minute until fragrant.
2.  **Build Flavor:** Stir in the tomato paste and curry paste, sautéing for another minute to release the oils.
3.  **Simmer:** Pour in the canned tomatoes and chickpeas. Cover and simmer on medium-high heat for 3–5 minutes.
4.  **Wilt Spinach:** Stir in the fresh spinach leaves until they wilt (about 1–2 minutes). Serve immediately.

---

### 2. 15-Minute Skillet Chickpeas with Spinach and Tomatoes
This Mediterranean-style dish uses spices like [turmeric](wiki:Turmeric) and a finishing touch of lemon juice for a bright, healthy meal.

[!](embed:runningonrealfood.com-R8H)
[!](embed:americanhomecook.com-Alt)
[!](embed:shortgirltallorder.com-QXv)

*   **Total Time:** 15 minutes
*   **Protein Content:** ~23.1g per serving
*   **Servings:** 2

**Ingredients:**
*   1 (15 oz) can chickpeas (drained and rinsed)
*   1 (14.5 oz) can diced tomatoes
*   5 oz baby spinach
*   1 small onion (diced) & 4 garlic cloves (sliced)
*   ½ tsp ground turmeric & ½ tsp [red pepper flakes](wiki:Crushed_red_pepper)
*   3 tbsp [olive oil](wiki:Olive_oil), lemon juice, and fresh herbs ([cilantro](wiki:Coriander) or [parsley](wiki:Parsley))

**Instructions:**
1.  **Fry Aromatics:** Heat oil in a skillet over low heat. Cook onion and garlic until translucent and slightly browned (3–5 minutes).
2.  **Toast Spices:** Add turmeric and red pepper flakes. Toast for 1 minute, then add chickpeas with a drizzle of oil and salt/pepper. Sizzle for 5–7 minutes.
3.  **Combine:** Stir in the tomatoes and simmer until the liquid reduces slightly.
4.  **Finish:** Add spinach and stir until wilted. Off the heat, stir in lemon juice and top with fresh herbs and a dollop of [yogurt](wiki:Yogurt).

---

### 3. 20-Minute Middle Eastern Spinach and Chickpeas
A simpler, cleaner version of the classic [tapas](wiki:Tapas) dish, focusing on the natural sweetness of sautéed onions and white beans.

[!](embed:carolinescooking.com-Dy7)
[!](embed:simpleveganblog.com-8dt)
[!](embed:ourplantbasedworld.com-Krr)

*   **Total Time:** 20 minutes
*   **Protein Content:** ~8.7g per serving
*   **Servings:** 4

**Ingredients:**
*   3 cups low-sodium canned chickpeas (drained and rinsed)
*   2 cups baby spinach
*   2/3 cup diced tomatoes
*   ½ large white onion (diced)
*   2 tsp minced garlic
*   1½ tbsp [extra-virgin olive oil](wiki:Olive_oil#Grades)

**Instructions:**
1.  **Soften Onions:** Heat olive oil in a pan. Sauté the onion for 2–3 minutes.
2.  **Add Seasoning:** Stir in the garlic and sauté for another minute.
3.  **Cook Down:** Pour in the tomatoes and cook for 1 minute.
4.  **Simmer Beans:** Add the chickpeas and about 3–4 tablespoons of water (or [vegetable broth](wiki:Broth)). Cook for 10 minutes.
5.  **Fold Spinach:** Gently fold in the baby spinach until just wilted. Season to taste and serve.

---

message_1.text: Draw a clear sequence diagram for how a user signs up with email verification, including the browser, API, email service, and database.

message_2.text:
This sequence diagram illustrates the standard "Double Opt-In" flow for user registration. This process ensures that the email address provided is valid and belongs to the user, which is a critical security step for protecting your community from spam and ensuring reliable communication.

```json
{"type": "mermaid", "embed_id": "ca024780-71b4-429b-8ffc-e3a5bdbe7eea"}
```

### Key Security Best Practices
1.  **Password Hashing**: Never store passwords in plain text. Use [Argon2](wiki:Argon2) or [bcrypt](wiki:Bcrypt) with a strong work factor.
2.  **Token Entropy**: The verification token should be a high-entropy cryptographically secure random string (e.g., [UUID v4](wiki:Universally_unique_identifier) or a 32-byte hex string).
3.  **Token Expiration**: Set a short expiration (e.g., 24 hours). This minimizes the window of opportunity if an email account is compromised.
4.  **Rate Limiting**: Implement [rate limiting](wiki:Rate_limiting) on the signup endpoint to prevent malicious actors from using your server to send "email bombs" or spamming your database.

### Why this flow builds a better community
By requiring email verification, you ensure that every member of your platform is reachable and has provided a legitimate point of contact. This reduces the prevalence of [botnets](wiki:Botnet) and fake accounts, which helps maintain a high level of trust and [social capital](wiki:Social_capital) within your digital space.

- Would you like to see the code implementation for the token generation and hashing in a specific language like **Node.js** or **Python**?

user_message_1.text: 为什么欧盟聊天控制法受到强烈批评？

```

"聊天控制"提案（官方名称为**欧盟儿童性虐待（CSA）条例**）已成为欧洲历史上争议最大的数字立法之一。尽管其声明目标是打击儿童性虐待，但批评者认为，所提议的方法将从根本上破坏互联网的安全和隐私基础设施。

截至**2026年4月**，这场辩论已到达关键转折点。允许科技公司自愿扫描消息的临时规则（**Chat Control 1.0**）已于**2026年4月3日**到期，此前[欧洲议会于3月拒绝了进一步延期](embed:stateofsurveillance.org-dRV)。

### 为何批评如此激烈

强烈批评源于安全目标与数字权利之间的几个根本性冲突：

#### 1. 加密的"后门"
最重要的批评涉及**端对端加密（E2EE）**。Signal和WhatsApp等服务使用E2EE，使得只有发送者和接收者才能读取消息。
*   **冲突：** 为了扫描这些消息中的非法内容，欧盟提议采用**"客户端扫描"**——在您的手机上安装软件，在照片和文本*被加密发送之前*进行检查。
*   **批评：** 安全专家和[隐私倡导者](embed:globalencryption.org-83i)认为，这实际上创建了一个"后门"。一旦这种机制存在，它就可能被黑客、外国情报机构或未来的威权政府利用，以监控任何类型的言论。

#### 2. 转向大规模监控
批评者，包括[欧洲数字权利组织](embed:fightchatcontrol.eu-YsN)，认为该法律正从"定向怀疑"（调查特定罪犯）转向"普遍监控"（扫描所有人的私生活）。
*   **批评：** 这将每个公民视为潜在嫌疑人。[欧洲人权法院](embed:globalencryption.org-83i)此前在*Podchasov v. Russia*等案件中裁定，削弱加密以实现大规模监控是对基本权利的不成比例侵犯。

#### 3. 技术不可靠性（"误报"问题）
该提案严重依赖人工智能来检测新的儿童虐待材料和"诱骗"（掠夺性行为）。
*   **批评：** 人工智能并不完美。独立[研究已指出较高的错误率](embed:en.wikipedia.org-Fav)，合法内容——例如父母将孩子在浴缸里的照片发给医生，或青少年分享经同意的图片——可能被标记并自动发送给警察。这可能用"噪音"压垮执法部门，同时侵犯无辜家庭的隐私。

#### 4. 弱势群体的脆弱性
讽刺的是，许多批评者指出，该法律可能伤害它本想保护的那些人。
*   **批评：** 隐私和加密对举报人、记者以及家庭暴力或政治迫害受害者至关重要。如果这些应用程序的安全性被削弱，这些弱势群体将失去用于沟通和寻求帮助的安全空间。

### 冲突总结

While I am unable to pull live, real-time pricing for your exact dates right this second, I can provide a highly reliable comparison of the absolute best family-friendly hotels in Kyoto based on historical October pricing, locations, and consistent guest ratings.

October is a peak travel month in Kyoto as the weather cools down and autumn foliage begins, so family rooms at these transit-friendly properties book up quickly!

Here is a comparison of four fantastic options for 2 adults and 1 child:

### 1. Mimaru Kyoto Station (The "Home Away From Home")
Mimaru is a beloved apartment-style hotel chain in Japan designed specifically with families in mind.
*   **Location:** Outstanding. It's just a 3 to 5-minute walk from Kyoto Station. This is perfect for quick access to the Shinkansen (bullet train), local subways, and the main bus terminal.
*   **Family Friendliness:** Excellent. They offer spacious rooms with small kitchenettes, dining tables, and even fun bunk-bed layouts which kids love.
*   **Typical October Price:** **$$$** (Usually between $250 - $400 USD / night)
*   **Guest Rating:** ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ **(4.8 / 5)** – Families consistently rate this as the best due to the sheer size of the rooms (a rarity in Japan).

### 2. Hotel Granvia Kyoto (The "Maximum Convenience")
If you want to completely eliminate transit stress, this is the place.
*   **Location:** Unbeatable. The hotel is literally integrated *inside* the massive Kyoto Station complex. You can step off your train and be in the lobby in minutes without ever stepping outside—ideal when traveling with a child and luggage.
*   **Family Friendliness:** Great. It's a large, traditional full-service luxury hotel. They offer larger family rooms and have plenty of dining options right downstairs in the station complex.
*   **Typical October Price:** **$$$$** (Usually between $350 - $600+ USD / night)
*   **Guest Rating:** ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️½ **(4.5 / 5)** – Rated very highly for its world-class service and unmatched convenience.

### 3. Cross Hotel Kyoto (The "Downtown Explorer")
If you prefer being near the lively cultural heart of the city rather than the main train station, this is a stylish option.
*   **Location:** Fantastic. Located near Sanjo Station and Kawaramachi. You have easy access to the subway and Keihan rail line, but you are also within walking distance of the famous Gion district, Pontocho Alley, and the Kamo River.
*   **Family Friendliness:** Very good. They offer spacious family rooms, and the location means you can easily take a family stroll for dinner without needing to hop on a train at the end of the day.
*   **Typical October Price:** **$$$** (Usually between $200 - $350 USD / night)
*   **Guest Rating:** ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ **(4.7 / 5)** – Highly praised for its beautiful modern design, superb breakfast, and quiet rooms despite the central location.

### 4. Karaksa Hotel Kyoto I (The "Budget-Friendly Connector")
Designed to be a modern, highly functional base camp for groups and families.
*   **Location:** Great. Located near Karasuma and Shijo subway stations (right in the middle of the city), giving you easy access to both the Kyoto Station area and the cultural sights in the north and east.
*   **Family Friendliness:** Excellent. They specialize in "connecting rooms," meaning you can book two adjoining rooms for extra space and privacy at a reasonable price, which is perfect for parents and an older child.
*   **Typical October Price:** **$$** (Usually between $150 - $250 USD / night)
*   **Guest Rating:** ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️½ **(4.5 / 5)** – Loved for its value, cleanliness, and thoughtful family-oriented layouts.

***

### Summary Comparison

*   **Best for Budget:** Karaksa Hotel
*   **Best for Transit & Day Trips:** Hotel Granvia & Mimaru Kyoto Station
*   **Best for Space & Amenities (Kitchen):** Mimaru Kyoto Station
*   **Best for Evening Strolls & Dining:** Cross Hotel Kyoto

Discussions about the [Fediverse](wiki:Fediverse) and [ActivityPub](wiki:ActivityPub) over the past week (June 1–8, 2026) have focused heavily on infrastructure growth beyond [Mastodon](wiki:Mastodon_(social_network)), the technical nuances of cross-protocol bridging, and server management.

### Recurring Themes

*   **The Rise of Non-Microblogging Platforms:** Data from trackers like [VM Crawl](embed:thefulcrum-eurosky-social-DrV) suggests a shift in the landscape. While Mastodon remains the face of the Fediverse, [Ghost](wiki:Ghost_(blogging_platform)) and [WordPress](wiki:WordPress) instances are rapidly increasing, indicating that "long-form" federated content is becoming a primary driver of network growth.
*   **Protocol Bridging (ActivityPub ↔ ATproto):** With Bluesky gaining traction, there is a significant push for interoperability. Users are actively sharing guides on using bridges like `brid.gy` to interact across [ActivityPub](wiki:ActivityPub) and [AT Protocol](wiki:AT_Protocol), specifically focusing on maintaining a consistent identity using custom domain handles.
*   **Technical Optimization & AI Defense:** Developers are discussing better ways to handle [federation](wiki:Federation_(information_technology)) flow, such as prioritizing HTTP "Accept" headers over User-Agent sniffing. There is also a notable focus on writing [WAF](wiki:Web_application_firewall) rules that allow Fediverse traffic while blocking [AI crawlers](wiki:Web_crawler) from [OpenAI](wiki:OpenAI).
*   **Decentralized Activism:** There is ongoing interest in how these technological models can scale grassroots activist organizing, moving beyond corporate-owned platforms to resilient, community-run infrastructure.

### Notable Links and Resources

*   **[Bridge Fediverse Accounts to Bluesky](embed:momtchil-momtchev-com-el3):** A detailed blog post by Chris McLeod on setting up custom domain handles for bridged accounts.
*   **VM Crawl Dashboard:** An analytics tool showing a heat map of detected ActivityPub platforms and instance comparisons.
*   **[GoToSocial Installation Guide](embed:fediverse-activitypub-awakari-PrM):** A "10-minute launch guide" for setting up the lightweight GoToSocial server on a Linux VPS.
*   **[Linked Data in HTTP Headers](embed:reiver-mastodon-social-y8F):** A technical breakdown of content negotiation for Fediverse servers.
*   **[Decentralized Networks Explained](embed:izby-bsky-social-Qqo):** A Russian-language primer (compatible with browser translators) on how Mastodon and the Fediverse differ from traditional social media.

Based on the current date of June 8, 2026, the Fediverse appears to be evolving from a "Mastodon-centric" network into a more diverse ecosystem of blogs and specialized tools, with a high priority on protecting these spaces from automated data scraping.

*   Should I look for specific discussions regarding [WordPress](wiki:WordPress) and [Ghost](wiki:Ghost_(blogging_platform)) federation settings?

```

这是一段非常迷人的电影史！你说得对，在 **1920 年代**，尤其是 [魏玛共和国](wiki:Weimar_Republic) 时期，以柏林为中心的德国确实是好莱坞唯一真正的全球竞争者。在艺术创新和技术声望上，许多电影史学者甚至认为它当时比美国电影工业更先进。

以下是柏林为何在那个黄金十年成为电影之都：

### 1. “施普雷河畔的好莱坞”
柏林因庞大的电影制作基础设施被称为 **“施普雷河畔的好莱坞”**。核心是 [巴贝尔斯贝格电影制片厂](wiki:Babelsberg_Studio)，它创立于 1912 年，至今仍是**世界上最古老的大型电影制片厂**。

好莱坞在产量上更多，但德国的 [UFA](wiki:UFA_GmbH) 是当时技术最先进的制片厂之一。它开创了“解放的摄影机”、复杂的摇臂和轨道运动，以及影响现代电影制作的特效技术。

[!](embed:portlandgermanfilmfestival.com-7p8)
[!](embed:studiobabelsberg.com-PK8)

### 2. 视觉杰作的诞生
默片时代许多最有影响力的作品来自德国。[德国表现主义](wiki:German_Expressionism) 通过扭曲布景、强烈阴影和心理深度，定义了后来的恐怖片、科幻片和 [黑色电影](wiki:Film_noir)。

*   **[大都会](wiki:Metropolis_(1927_film)) (1927)：** [弗里茨·朗](wiki:Fritz_Lang) 的科幻里程碑，拥有好莱坞当时几乎难以匹敌的巨型布景和影像。
*   **[卡里加里博士的小屋](wiki:The_Cabinet_of_Dr._Caligari) (1920)：** 帮助发明恐怖片与黑色电影视觉语言的作品。
*   **[诺斯费拉图](wiki:Nosferatu) (1922)：** [F.W. 茂瑙](wiki:F.W._Murnau) 对 *Dracula* 的非官方改编，至今仍是最震撼的恐怖电影之一。

[!](embed:dailyartmagazine.com-9Tk)

### 3. 为什么局面改变了
柏林的主导地位在 1930 年代初逐渐衰落，主要有两个原因：

1.  **经济危机：** 大萧条重创德国，像 *Metropolis* 这样昂贵的史诗片几乎拖垮制片厂。
2.  **纳粹崛起：** 1933 年后，许多犹太裔和反纳粹艺术家逃往美国。

[弗里茨·朗](wiki:Fritz_Lang)、[比利·怀尔德](wiki:Billy_Wilder)、[恩斯特·刘别谦](wiki:Ernst_Lubitsch) 等导演，以及 [玛琳·黛德丽](wiki:Marlene_Dietrich) 等明星，把柏林风格带到了好莱坞。这也是 1940 年代美国黑色电影和环球恐怖片深受 1920 年代德国电影影响的原因。

### 4. 今天的巴贝尔斯贝格
[巴贝尔斯贝格电影制片厂](wiki:Babelsberg_Studio) 仍在运营。2000 年代以来，*[布达佩斯大饭店](wiki:The_Grand_Budapest_Hotel)*、*[无耻混蛋](wiki:Inglourious_Basterds)* 和 *[John Wick: Chapter 4](wiki:John_Wick:_Chapter_4)* 等作品都曾在那里拍摄。

**你看过这些默片经典吗，还是更想了解在柏林拍摄的现代电影？** 我也可以帮你找到观看渠道，或设置一个[提醒](/#settings/apps/reminder)去查相关纪录片。

title.text: Prepare for a housing policy dinner discussion

summary.text: A two-turn politics focus-mode chat that helps prepare calm, balanced questions for a family discussion about rent control and housing policy.

message_1.text: I'm having dinner with my dad and he wants to argue about housing policy and rent controls. Help me prepare so I can ask good questions, check key facts, understand the strongest arguments on both sides, and keep the conversation calm.

message_2.text: Focus mode activated: Prepare a political discussion.

message_3.text: Great. Please make me a practical prep sheet: what facts should I verify before dinner, what are the strongest good-faith arguments on each side, and what exact questions can I ask if the conversation starts getting tense?

message_4.text:
It is incredibly thoughtful of you to prepare for this. Family conversations about policy can quickly turn into debates where both sides are just waiting for their turn to speak, rather than actually listening. 

Since housing touches on fundamental human needs, property rights, and community survival, it’s a deeply emotional topic. The best way to keep the conversation calm is to shift the dynamic from a **competitive debate** ("Who is right?") to a **collaborative exploration** ("How do we solve this complex problem together?").

Here is a breakdown of the strongest arguments on both sides, key facts to ground the conversation, and strategic questions you can ask to keep the dinner constructive.

### 1. The Core Debate: Rent Control & Stabilization

To have a productive conversation, it helps to distinguish between **strict rent control** (freezing rents completely, which is rare today) and **rent stabilization** (capping annual rent increases at a certain percentage, often tied to inflation). 

**The Strongest Arguments AGAINST Rent Control (The Market & Supply View)**
*   **It discourages new housing construction:** If developers and investors believe their future revenue will be capped by the government, they may choose not to build new housing, which worsens the overall housing shortage.
*   **It reduces housing quality:** If landlords cannot raise rents to cover the rising costs of maintenance and property taxes, they often defer repairs, leading to the deterioration of the housing stock.
*   **It creates "misallocation":** Renters in rent-controlled units rarely move, even if their family size shrinks (e.g., empty nesters staying in a 3-bedroom apartment). This prevents younger, growing families from accessing that space.
*   **It helps incumbents, not necessarily the poorest:** Rent control benefits those who already have an apartment. Newcomers to a city, or young people trying to move out of their parents' homes, face an even tighter, more expensive market because turnover is so low.

**The Strongest Arguments FOR Rent Control (The Community & Equity View)**
*   **It prevents immediate displacement:** Building new housing takes years. In the meantime, massive rent spikes can evict families, push people into homelessness, and destroy the social fabric of neighborhoods. Rent control acts as an immediate emergency brake.
*   **Neighborhoods are communities, not just markets:** Treating housing purely as a financial commodity ignores the human cost of displacement. Kids having to switch schools, local businesses losing regular customers, and workers being pushed hours away from their jobs damages the whole community.
*   **Power imbalance:** In a severe housing shortage, landlords have a functional monopoly. Renters cannot simply "shop elsewhere" if there is a 1% vacancy rate. Rent stabilization levels the playing field so tenants aren't exploited by a captive market.
*   **Modern stabilization is moderate:** Most modern policies (like Oregon's or California's state-wide caps) allow for inflation plus a percentage (e.g., 7-10% a year) and exempt brand-new construction. This protects tenants from *predatory* spikes (like a sudden $500 increase) without stopping developers from making a fair profit.

### 2. Facts to Keep in Your Back Pocket
*   **The Consensus:** Historically, the vast majority of traditional economists have agreed that *strict* price ceilings reduce the quantity and quality of housing. However, recent economic studies on *moderate* rent stabilization show mixed results—they are highly effective at keeping current tenants housed, but can still marginally reduce the supply of available rental units.
*   **The Root Cause is Supply:** The US has a deficit of millions of housing units following the 2008 financial crash. We simply haven't built enough homes to keep up with population growth. 
*   **Zoning Laws:** In many major North American cities, 70% or more of residential land is zoned *exclusively* for single-family homes. This makes it illegal to build duplexes, townhomes, or small apartment buildings, artificially choking the housing supply.

### 3. Strategies to Keep It Calm
*   **Find the shared value early:** Does your dad care most about fairness? Economic efficiency? People not being homeless? Property rights? Once you identify his core value, validate it. *(e.g., "I agree with you that property owners shouldn't be forced to operate at a loss.")*
*   **Ask for his process, not just his conclusion:** Instead of attacking his stance, ask him to walk you through how his ideal system would handle edge cases.
*   **Expand the scope:** Rent control is just one tool. If you get stuck, zoom out to the broader housing crisis (zoning, public housing, corporate buying of single-family homes).

### 4. Great Questions to Ask Your Dad

These questions are designed to make him think actively rather than just recite talking points, and they invite collaborative problem-solving:

1.  **If he is AGAINST rent control:** *"I understand the economic argument that rent caps limit new construction. But building new housing takes 3 to 5 years. If a single mom's rent goes up by 40% tomorrow, what policy should we use to keep her and her kids from being displaced right now?"*
2.  **If he is FOR rent control:** *"If we cap what landlords can charge, how do we make sure they still have enough money and incentive to fix the roof and replace the plumbing? How do we prevent buildings from falling apart?"*
3.  **Zooming out to the bigger picture:** *"A lot of experts say the real issue is that it's illegal to build anything other than single-family homes in most parts of our cities. Do you think we should abolish those zoning laws to let developers build more apartments?"*
4.  **Finding balance:** *"How do we balance a property owner's right to make a return on their investment with a community's need to have stable neighbors who aren't constantly forced to move?"*

How are you leaning personally on this issue heading into the dinner? Are you hoping to advocate for a specific side, or are you mostly looking to play devil's advocate and learn?

Based on your interest in learning [Rust](wiki:Rust_(programming_language)), [WebAssembly](wiki:WebAssembly), and Asynchronous programming patterns, I suggest building a **Web-Based Real-Time Image Filter**.

This project is an ideal entry point because it provides immediate visual feedback and highlights why WebAssembly is valuable.

### The Project: Rust-Powered Image Processor
The goal is to create a simple web page where you can upload an image and apply filters (like grayscale, sepia, or brightness) using a Rust backend compiled to Wasm.

**Why this fits your goals:**
*   **WebAssembly:** You will use `wasm-pack` and `wasm-bindgen` to bridge the gap between [JavaScript](wiki:JavaScript) and Rust, learning how to pass large buffers of memory (pixel data) between the two.
*   **Rust Fundamentals:** You'll practice using [Iterators](wiki:Iterator) and handling raw byte arrays efficiently.
*   **Async Patterns:** You can extend the project by using [Future](wiki:Futures_and_promises) patterns in Rust to handle file loading or to offload the processing to a [Web worker](wiki:Web_worker), ensuring the UI remains responsive during heavy computation.

**Suggested Weekend Roadmap:**
1.  **Setup:** Initialize a project with `wasm-pack` and set up a basic HTML/JS frontend with a `<canvas>` element.
2.  **The Bridge:** Write a Rust function that takes a `Vec<u8>` (representing RGBA pixels), iterates through them to calculate grayscale values, and returns the modified vector.
3.  **Optimization:** Once the basic filter works, explore using Rayon or internal async tasks to see if you can parallelize the pixel processing for very large images.

This project directly applies what you've shared about your learning path by combining high-performance computation with modern web integration.

message_2.text:
Based on your saved learning goals for **Linear Algebra for machine learning and graphics**, here is a structured one-week study plan designed to build intuition and practical understanding before moving into formal proofs.

### One-Week Linear Algebra Intensive

**Day 1: The Geometry of Vectors and Linear Transformations**
Focus on visualizing vectors not just as lists of numbers, but as arrows in space. Study how a matrix acts as a function that transforms space (stretching, squishing, or rotating it).
*   **Key Concept:** Understand that matrix-vector multiplication $Ax$ is a linear combination of the columns of $A$.

**Day 2: Matrix Multiplication as Composition**
Instead of focusing on the "row-by-column" arithmetic, view the product $AB$ as the composition of two transformations. Applying $B$ first, then $A$.
*   **Key Concept:** Why order matters (Matrix multiplication is not commutative).

**Day 3: Determinants and the Change of Area**
Learn the determinant as the factor by which a transformation scales areas (in 2D) or volumes (in 3D). This provides the intuition for why a zero determinant means the transformation squishes space into a lower dimension.
*   **Key Concept:** The relationship between the determinant and matrix invertibility.

**Day 4: Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors**
Find the special "hidden" axes of a transformation—the vectors that only get scaled (not knocked off their span) during the transformation.
*   **Key Concept:** $Ax = \lambda x$. The eigenvector $x$ is the direction, and the eigenvalue $\lambda$ is the scale factor.

**Day 5: Matrix Decompositions (The ML Foundation)**
Introduce the concept of breaking a complex matrix into simpler, interpretable parts. Focus on the intuition behind Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) and how it relates to data compression.
*   **Key Concept:** How SVD "factors" a transformation into a rotation, a stretch, and another rotation.

**Day 6: Applications in Graphics and ML**
Study how 4x4 matrices are used in computer graphics for translation, rotation, and perspective projection. Briefly look at how Principal Component Analysis (PCA) uses eigenvectors to find the directions of maximum variance in a dataset.
*   **Key Concept:** Change of basis and coordinate systems.

**Day 7: Practical Exercise and Review**
Consolidate the week's concepts by working through a manual transformation exercise.

***

### Practical Exercise: The "Hand-Drawn" Transformation

To build your intuition for graphics and matrix operations, perform the following exercise:

1.  **Define a Shape:** On a piece of graph paper (or a digital equivalent), plot three points: $A(1, 1)$, $B(3, 1)$, and $C(2, 3)$. Connect them to form a triangle.
2.  **Create a Transformation Matrix:** Use the matrix $M = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & -1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix}$.
3.  **Apply the Transformation:** Multiply each point (as a column vector) by $M$.
    *   Example for point $A$: $\begin{bmatrix} 0 & -1 \\ 1 & 0 \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} -1 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix}$.
4.  **Analyze the Result:** Plot the three new points ($A', B', C'$).
    *   **Observation:** You will see the triangle has rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise.
5.  **Challenge:** Try to find a new 2x2 matrix that would "squish" the triangle so its area becomes zero. (Hint: Think about the determinant).

For a **€350,000** mortgage with an annual interest rate of **3.8%** over **25 years**, here is the breakdown of your monthly payments and the total interest you would pay.

### 1. The Formula
To calculate the monthly payment ($M$), we use the standard [amortization](wiki:Amortization) formula:

$$M = P \frac{r(1+r)^n}{(1+r)^n - 1}$$

**Where:**
*   **$P$ (Principal):** €350,000
*   **$r$ (Monthly Interest Rate):** $3.8\% / 12$ months = $0.00316667$
*   **$n$ (Total Number of Payments):** $25 \text{ years} \times 12 \text{ months} = 300$

### 2. Monthly Payment Calculation
Based on the values above, your monthly payment would be:
**€1,809.00** Calculation result

### 3. Total Interest Paid
To find the total interest, we multiply the monthly payment by the number of months and subtract the original loan amount:
$$\text{Total Interest} = (M \times n) - P$$

*   **Total Amount Paid:** €542,699.39
*   **Total Interest:** **€192,699.39**

Let's dive into customer discovery. The goal here is not to pitch our solution, but to diagnose how painful their current compliance friction is and whether they are actively losing billable hours or deals because of it.

Here is a practical, rigorous interview plan for our first 20 prospects.

---

### 1. Prospect Segments to Recruit (Target: 20 Interviews)
We want to balance density within specific verticals to find patterns:
* **Segment A (Legal / Compliance — 7 prospects):** Partners or associates at boutique law firms (IP, corporate M&A) who handle sensitive contracts daily.
* **Segment B (Finance / Wealth Management — 7 prospects):** Independent financial advisors, wealth managers, or boutique M&A/private equity analysts dealing with non-public financial data.
* **Segment C (Deep-Tech / Engineering Consultancies — 6 prospects):** Technical founders or engineering leads whose clients require strict NDA/IP separation.

---

### 2. Outreach Positioning
*Never pitch software.* Position the call around research into workflow security and productivity bottlenecks. 
* **Subject Line:** Quick question on AI & client confidentiality at [Firm Name]
* **Body Example:**
  > *"Hi [Name], I’m researching how boutique [law/wealth management] firms balance the productivity gains of AI with strict client confidentiality and NDA requirements. We're talking to 20 industry leaders to understand where current tools fail your compliance standards. Would you be open to a 20-minute chat next week? No sales pitch—just want to learn from your workflow challenges."*

---

### 3. Interview Script (20 Minutes)
* **Context Setting (2 mins):** 
  > *"Thanks for making time. We’re exploring how professionals with high confidentiality standards handle modern productivity tools. I want to learn about your actual workflows, not pitch you anything."*
* **Current State & Behavior (5 mins):**
  > * "Walk me through how you currently handle tasks like synthesizing long client depositions, confidential financial reports, or drafting complex agreements."
  > * "Have you or anyone on your team tried using mainstream AI tools (like ChatGPT or Claude) for these tasks? What happened?"
* **The Pain & Friction (5 mins):**
  > * "If you *did* use AI for sensitive documents, what specific guardrails or partner policies stopped you? Were they enforced by firm policy, client contracts, or your own peace of mind?"
  > * "Can you estimate how many hours a week your team spends on manual drafting or synthesis because you can't use standard automation?"
* **Economic Impact & Workarounds (5 mins):**
  > * "What workarounds do you use today? (e.g., sanitizing text, using generic templates, or just doing it all manually)?"
  > * "If a tool guaranteed zero data retention and local execution, how would that change your team's output?"
* **Wrap-up (3 mins):**
  > * "If we built a secure utility for this, would you be open to testing an early prototype with your team?"

---

### 4. Signals That Validate Urgency (Green Lights 🟢)
We look for behavioral evidence, not polite compliments:
* **"Hair-on-fire" compliance fear:** They can cite a specific client contract clause, data breach fear, or partner mandate that explicitly bans cloud-based AI.
* **Active shadow IT or workarounds:** They admit team members are already pasting sensitive data into consumer AI tools under personal accounts because the productivity boost is too tempting to ignore (massive risk = massive urgency).
* **Quantifiable time loss:** They report losing 5+ hours per week per person on tasks an LLM could solve if privacy wasn't a barrier.
* **Immediate willingness to pilot:** They agree on the spot to be a design partner for a restricted internal alpha.

---

### 5. Signals That Tell Us to Pivot (Red Lights 🔴)
We must be honest with ourselves if the market isn't there:
* **Indifference to AI:** If they say, *"We don't really use AI or see the need for it in our workflows,"* the productivity pain isn't acute enough.
* **Enterprise lock-in:** If they say, *"We are an enterprise Microsoft/Google shop, and our IT department is rolling out an internal secure copilot next month anyway,"* boutique wedge buyers will just wait for their existing stack to solve it.
* **Regulatory apathy:** If compliance is treated as a check-the-box formality rather than a core business risk, they won't pay a premium for ironclad privacy.

---

message_6.text:
Let's evaluate the technical architecture for our privacy-first copilot. Choosing the right architecture for Day 1 dictates our infrastructure costs, developer velocity, and how easily we can pass a strict security audit during customer discovery.

Here is a comparison of the three architectural approaches, followed by a tradeoff matrix and our recommended first version.

---

### 1. Architectural Options Compared

#### Option A: Local-Only Desktop App (Air-Gapped / Edge Execution)
* **How it works:** A native desktop application (built with Tauri or Electron) bundles a runtime like [Ollama](wiki:Ollama) or Llamafile along with lightweight Small Language Models (SLMs) such as Llama 3 (8B) or Mistral 7B. Inference runs entirely on the user's CPU/GPU.
* **Data Flow:** Zero data leaves the local machine. Files are indexed locally (e.g., via SQLite/LanceDB embedded vector stores).

#### Option B: Encrypted Cloud Workspace with Zero-Retention API Calls
* **How it works:** A web or desktop app where user documents are encrypted client-side using user-held keys (zero-knowledge architecture). When an AI request is made, text is decrypted in memory on an isolated, ephemeral cloud container running open-source models on rented GPUs (e.g., AWS Nitro Enclaves or dedicated instances with non-logging vendor agreements).
* **Data Flow:** Data transits in ciphertext, hits a stateless container, runs inference, and vanishes immediately with no logging.

#### Option C: Hybrid Local-Plus-Cloud Routing
* **How it works:** The app dynamically classifies user prompts. Simple or highly sensitive queries (e.g., parsing an unredacted legal contract) are processed locally by an SLM. Complex reasoning or heavy synthesis tasks are automatically scrubbed of PII locally, then routed to a secure enterprise-grade cloud API (e.g., Anthropic or OpenAI enterprise tiers).
* **Data Flow:** Split between local execution and encrypted cloud payloads.

---

### 2. Tradeoff Matrix

```json
{"type": "sheet", "embed_id": "bd4554c1-5ac6-46b1-8b53-a5450c95b717"}
```

---

### 3. Recommended First Version: Option A (Local-Only Desktop App)

For our **First 90-Day MVP**, we should strictly commit to **Option A: Local-Only Desktop App**.

#### Why this wins for a zero-to-one startup:
1. **The "Zero-Trust" Shortcut:** During customer discovery, regulated prospects will immediately object to cloud architecture ("We need legal review for any new SaaS vendor handling data"). A local-only app completely bypasses vendor risk assessments and IT security sign-offs because *no data ever touches our servers*. 
2. **Infinite Gross Margins on Day 1:** We don't have to raise capital just to pay for heavy GPU cloud inference bills while validating product-market fit.
3. **Product Focus:** It forces us to build an incredible, tightly scoped UX for document chunking, meeting transcription, and local context retrieval without getting bogged down in secure multi-tenant cloud infrastructure.

#### The Strategic Pivot Path:
Once we lock down design partners who love the local app but complain about hardware limits or context length on their local laptops, we can introduce an opt-in **Option B (Zero-Retention Cloud Workspace)** as an enterprise tier down the road.

***

What would you like to plan next? We can explore **MVP Feature Scope & UX Design** for this desktop app, or dive straight into structuring our **Go-to-Market & Initial Design Partner Outreach**.

message_7.text: @ai-model:gemini-3.5-flash-lite Continue with MVP feature scope and UX. Define the smallest lovable workflow for the local-only desktop app, including onboarding, local file indexing, meeting transcript ingestion, document Q&A, draft generation, and privacy controls. message_8.text:
Let's lock down the **MVP Feature Scope and UX** for our local-only desktop app. 

To make this product truly lovable (not just functional), we need to solve the friction of setting up local models while delivering an interface that feels as snappy and polished as a modern cloud SaaS tool (like Notion or Raycast), but running 100% offline.

Here is the feature scope and UX roadmap categorized by priority:

---

### 1. Must-Have Features (Day 1 MVP Scope)
*These are non-negotiable for our first private alpha release to design partners.*

* **One-Click Local Model Setup (Onboarding):**
  * *UX:* Upon downloading the lightweight Tauri app, a clean setup wizard automatically checks the user's hardware (e.g., Apple Silicon vs. Windows/NVIDIA), downloads an optimized Small Language Model (like Llama 3 8B quantized), and runs a quick verification test. No command line required.
* **Secure Local Folder Indexing:**
  * *UX:* A simple "Connect Workspace" button lets users select local folders (e.g., `/Client_Contracts/`) containing PDFs, Word docs, and markdown files. The app builds an embedded local vector index (using SQLite/LanceDB) entirely on device.
* **Meeting Transcript Ingestion:**
  * *UX:* A drag-and-drop zone for raw audio/video files or text transcripts (.txt, .srt, .vtt) from local meeting recorders (like Otter exports or local OBS recordings). The app chunks and indexes the transcript instantly.
* **Context-Aware Document Q&A & Synthesis:**
  * *UX:* A clean chat interface where users can query their indexed documents (`@ClientA contract terms`) and get precise, cited answers grounded strictly in local files without hitting external APIs.
* **Draft Generation with Guardrails:**
  * *UX:* A side-by-side editor where users can highlight local notes or transcripts and prompt the model: *"Draft an executive summary email to the client based on this transcript."*
* **Visible Privacy Status Bar:**
  * *UX:* A permanent, calming green badge in the corner of the app: `🟢 Air-Gapped / Zero Network Activity`, giving users instant psychological safety.

---

### 2. Should-Have Features (Fast Follows — Months 2–3)
*Important for retention, but not strictly required to prove core value during initial user testing.*

For a privacy-first product, trust is our primary asset. We aren't running broad ad campaigns; we are conducting a selective, high-trust concierge recruitment campaign to find professionals who feel the compliance bottleneck most acutely.

---

### Phase 1: Recruitment & Channels (Days 1–10)

#### 1. Target Channels
* **Warm Professional Networks:** Direct outreach to founder contacts, angel investors, and friendly startup lawyers or wealth managers who fit our ICP.
* **Boutique Professional Communities:** Curated Slack/Discord groups, regional bar association tech committees, and independent financial advisor networks.
* **LinkedIn Precision Outbound:** Targeting partners at 5–25 person boutique firms (IP law, M&A advisory, boutique wealth management) using the "Research & Feedback" angle.

#### 2. Messaging Angles (The Hook)
* **The Compliance Friction Angle:** *"We're building an air-gapped, zero-data-retention AI workspace specifically for firms bound by strict client confidentiality and NDAs. No cloud logging, no data exposure. Looking for 3 boutique partners to stress-test our early prototype."*

#### 3. Strict Qualification Criteria (Who makes the cut?)
To ensure high signal-to-noise, prospective design partners must meet three conditions:
1. **The Policy Hurdle:** They or their firm are currently restricted from using mainstream AI (ChatGPT, Claude enterprise-free tiers) due to client agreements or regulatory fears.
2. **The Volume Hurdle:** They personally spend 5+ hours per week reviewing contracts, synthesizing messy meeting transcripts, or drafting sensitive correspondence.
3. **Hardware Readiness:** They (or their team members) use modern developer or professional machines (Apple Silicon M1/M2/M3 or discrete NVIDIA GPUs) capable of running local models smoothly.

---

### Phase 2: Incentives & Onboarding (Days 11–15)

#### 1. Design Partner Incentives
* **Lifetime Early-Adopter Pricing / VIP Access:** Free lifetime access to the desktop app and future pro tiers in exchange for active participation.
* **Direct Engineering Influence:** Their specific workflow bottlenecks become top-priority items on our weekly product sprint board.

#### 2. Concierge Onboarding Process
* **1-on-1 White-Glove Setup (30 Minutes):** We don't just send a download link. We jump on a video call, help them install the Tauri desktop app, verify their hardware compatibility, guide the automatic model download, and index their first test folder together.
* **Baseline Workflow Mapping:** During the onboarding call, we identify *one* specific recurring task (e.g., "summarizing weekly client deposition transcripts") to test during their first week.

---

### Phase 3: Weekly Feedback Cadence & Operations (Days 16–30)

#### 1. Structured Feedback Loop
* **Weekly 15-Minute Syncs (Weeks 3 & 4):** A quick check-in covering three questions:
  1. *What did you use the tool for this week, and where did it save you time?*
  2. *Where did the model hallucinate, feel sluggish, or frustrate you?*
  3. *What file formats or integrations are missing that blocked you from using it more?*
* **Async Bug & Feature Reporting:** A dedicated, private Slack/Telegram channel or a lightweight in-app feedback widget for instant bug reporting.

---

### Phase 4: Success Metrics (How We Measure Victory at Day 30)

We aren't tracking vanity signups. We measure true engagement:
1. **Retention / Active Usage:** At least 7 out of 10 design partners open and use the local app **3+ times per week** for real client work.
2. **Qualitative "Aha!" Moment:** At least 3 partners explicitly state: *"I couldn't have done [Task X] this fast without risking compliance violations."*
3. **Friction Identification:** Clear documentation of hardware limits, model latency bottlenecks, and UX friction points to fix before expanding the cohort.

---

### Next Steps & Action Plan

With our thesis, customer discovery plan, technical architecture, MVP scope, and 30-day GTM strategy mapped out, our foundational zero-to-one blueprint is complete.

Let's map out a comprehensive **Product Requirements Document (PRD)** for our privacy-first Tauri desktop client wrapper. This document will serve as our engineering north star for the 30-day MVP build.

---

# Product Requirements Document (PRD): Privacy-First Local AI Workspace (Tauri MVP)

## 1. Document Metadata
* **Product Name:** Project Citadel (Working Title)
* **Target Release:** 30-Day MVP / Private Alpha
* **Author:** Operating Partner & Engineering Lead
* **Status:** Draft / Approved for Sprint 1

---

## 2. Target Users & Persona
* **Primary Persona:** Boutique firm partners, senior associates, and independent consultants handling sensitive client files, legal contracts, or confidential financial data who are barred from using standard cloud AI tools due to NDA and compliance restrictions.

---

## 3. Core Jobs-To-Be-Done (JTBD)
1. *"When I have a 50-page confidential client contract, I want to query specific clauses locally so I can find answers instantly without leaking proprietary text to a cloud server."*
2. *"When I finish a sensitive client deposition or advisory call, I want to drop the raw audio or transcript into a private tool and generate an executive summary draft without data leaving my laptop."*

---

## 4. User Stories
* **US-1 (Onboarding):** As a user, I want the app to automatically detect my hardware and download a secure local language model with one click, so I don't have to configure command-line runtimes.
* **US-2 (Folder Indexing):** As a user, I want to select a local folder of PDF/docx files so the app can securely index them into an offline vector database.
* **US-3 (Document Q&A):** As a user, I want to chat with my indexed documents and receive precise, cited answers grounded entirely in local files.
* **US-4 (Draft Generation):** As a user, I want to highlight local notes or transcripts and prompt the model to draft an email or summary.
* **US-5 (Privacy Assurance):** As a user, I want visual confirmation that my app is completely air-gapped so I have absolute peace of mind regarding data sovereignty.

---

## 5. Functional Requirements
* **FR-1: Cross-Platform Desktop Shell:** Built using Tauri (Rust backend, web frontend) for lightweight resource usage and fast startup times.
* **FR-2: Local Inference Runtime Integration:** Bundled or auto-managed local model runner (e.g., Ollama or embedded llama.cpp) supporting quantized models (Llama 3 8B / Mistral 7B).
* **FR-3: Local File Parser & Vector Store:**
  * Support parsing `.pdf`, `.docx`, `.txt`, and `.md` files.
  * Embedded local vector storage (SQLite + SQLite-VSS or LanceDB) stored locally in the user's application support directory.
* **FR-4: Chat & Prompt Interface:** Clean, split-pane chat interface supporting markdown output, source document citations, and prompt history saved locally.
* **FR-5: Air-Gapped Status Indicator:** Persistent UI badge displaying network isolation status (`🟢 Air-Gapped`).

---

## 6. Non-Functional Privacy & Security Requirements
* **NFR-1: Zero Telemetry & Network Isolation:** The application executable must operate 100% offline post-model download. Outbound network calls are strictly restricted to local model registry downloads (optional user action) and blocked otherwise.
* **NFR-2: Local-Only Data Persistence:** All chat histories, embeddings, and vector indices must reside exclusively in encrypted or sandboxed local storage directories (`~/Library/Application Support/...` or equivalent OS paths). No database sync to external cloud buckets.
* **NFR-3: Memory Hygiene:** Sensitive prompt strings and decrypted document chunks must be cleared from process memory immediately upon session termination or app close.

---

## 7. Acceptance Criteria (MVP Gate)
* [ ] Application successfully installs on macOS (Apple Silicon) and Windows 11 via a signed installer.
* [ ] One-click setup downloads and verifies Llama 3 8B within 3 minutes on standard hardware.
* [ ] User can index a folder of 20 PDFs (approx. 50 pages each) locally without crashing or exceeding 4GB RAM utilization.
* [ ] User can ask a targeted question about the documents and receive a grounded answer with inline citations in under 5 seconds.
* [ ] Network monitor verification confirms **zero outgoing packets** to third-party endpoints during active chat and indexing operations.

---

## 8. Explicit Out-of-Scope (Deferred to Post-MVP)
* Cloud-based fallback or hybrid routing to OpenAI/Anthropic APIs.
* Real-time audio recording and transcription (Whisper.cpp integration deferred to Fast Follow).
* Multi-user P2P workspace sharing or encrypted cloud sync.
* Windows on ARM (WOA) optimization.

---

### Suggested Next Steps
With our PRD complete, we can begin sketching the initial **UI Wireframe/Architecture** or start mapping out the **Sprint 1 Engineering Tasks** for the Tauri/Rust core.
